title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-Margined ASRUSDT and ALPINEUSDT Perpetual Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance Futures will launch the following perpetual contracts as below: 2025-05-06 09:30 (UTC):  ASRUSDT  Perpetual Contract with up to 75x leverage 2025-05-06 09:45 (UTC):  ALPINEUSDT  Perpetual Contract with up to 75x leverage More details on the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract ASRUSDT ALPINEUSDT Launch Time 2025-05-06 09:30 (UTC) 2025-05-06 09:45 (UTC) Underlying Asset ASR (AS Roma Fan Token) ALPINE (Alpine F1 Team Fan Token) Contract Address 0x235639F72E127bBdd1509BFC9DC6e2caeb3FB741 0x287880Ea252b52b63Cc5f40a2d3E5A44aa665a76 Project Info AS Roma Fan Token (ASR) offers a unique blend of digital engagement and real-world experiences for fans of the AS Roma football club. Alpine F1 Team Fan Token (ALPINE) is the first Formula One-themed fan token by Binance. Settlement Asset USDT USDT Tick Size 0.001 0.0001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 75x 75x Trading Hours 24/7 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Supported Please Note:   The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  this FAQ . The maximum funding rate of the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned Futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the aforementioned perpetual contract(s).  The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) are subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Futures and spot token listings are  not correlated . A token listed on Binance Futures  does not guarantee  that it will be listed on Binance Spot.
